projects.title: Printer-ESC-POS
projects.description: A powerful Kotlin library for ESC/POS thermal printers, supporting Bluetooth, USB, and TCP connections.

details.longDescription: Printer-ESC-POS is a premier open-source Kotlin library built to solve the fragmentation of thermal printing APIs on Android. It handles character set mapping, bitmap rendering, barcode/QR configurations, and low-level byte-command packaging for various hardware channels.
features: Universal ESC/POS byte generator for Bluetooth, USB, and TCP sockets
Advanced bitmap conversion algorithms for printing high-contrast logos
Comprehensive multi-language formatting and text alignment
Supports standard barcodes and high-density QR code prints
details.challenges: Fragmented thermal printer hardware support. Solved by implementing standard buffering, customizable line-feed delays, and custom character-encoding tables.

projects.title: Diggo POS Android
projects.description: A comprehensive Point of Sale system for Android, featuring inventory management and transaction tracking.

details.longDescription: Diggo POS is a modern retail solution that aggregates inventory management, real-time sales reporting, and cash register flows. Built with standard clean design, it operates flawlessly offline and synchronizes data asynchronously when online.
features: Offline-first operational state using SQLite/Room buffering
Dynamic pricing grids and tax computation matrices
Direct integration with Bluetooth ESC/POS receipt printers via Printer-ESC-POS
Analytics chart interface for daily and monthly sales reporting
details.challenges: Data synchronization conflicts when running multiple POS terminals offline. Solved by implementing vector clocks and conflict-free replicated data strategies.

projects.title: POS LaundryQ
projects.description: Niche POS solution tailored for laundry businesses with order status monitoring and customer database.

details.longDescription: POS LaundryQ is a dedicated workflow app for laundromat services, helping employees track orders through various stages (Received, Washing, Ironing, Ready for Pickup, Delivered) and keeping clients updated via SMS or WhatsApp notifications.
features: Kanban-style laundry order status tracking board
Customer deposit packages and balance management
Automatic automated notification updates based on order status
Multi-employee role permissions management
details.challenges: Real-time sync of washing queue states across multiple mobile clients. Resolved via Firebase Firestore live query snapshot streams.

projects.title: Hotel BE
projects.description: Robust back-end service for hotel management systems, handling bookings, room status, and guest data.

details.longDescription: Hotel BE is a microservices backend serving as the central coordinator for reservation channels, room inventory databases, guest profiles, and invoice billing protocols.
features: RESTful APIs for check-in/check-out allocations
JWT-based security filters and role management controls
Database transaction isolation to prevent double booking of suites
Automated PDF invoice email receipts generation
details.challenges: Handling concurrent room reservation races at peak hours. Resolved using optimistic locking annotations on room records.

projects.title: TV Schedule
projects.description: Real-time television scheduling application with reminder notifications and channel listings.

details.longDescription: An android application that queries live schedule API providers to display channel showtimes, cataloging movies and series, and setting system notifications to alert users before shows start.
features: Live show schedule timelines with smooth paging lists
Notification scheduler using Android AlarmManager API
Favorites lists caching utilizing local SQLite database
Material Design search filters for channels and categories
details.challenges: Alarm triggers not firing consistently on customized Android OEM OS skins. Solved using WorkManager and precise battery optimization whitelist intents.

projects.title: Synapse
projects.description: Innovative development project focused on data processing and system synchronization.

details.longDescription: Synapse is a research project aiming to develop cross-platform background data synchronization libraries using Kotlin Multiplatform. It abstracts background workers across Android (WorkManager) and iOS (BackgroundTasks) to maintain consistent offline databases.
features: Shared KMP business logic module compiled to iOS framework and Android AAR
Cross-platform SQLite database schema sharing via SQLDelight
Durable batch synchronization queues with automated exponential backoff retry
Low-battery network connection awareness
details.challenges: Managing asynchronous threading consistency on iOS native dispatch queues within KMP. Solved using Coroutines Native-MT and state isolation wrappers.
